review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its definitions with Mathlib. The definitions are scalarEmbedding, curlTest and curlTestLp. The rest are theorems, which are out of scope. Mathlib has no named counterpart to the embedding r ↦ r • e₀ beyond toSpanSingleton and EuclideanSpace.single. So the only duplication I found is inside the project: three independent definitions of the same map ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3). I did not check the import graph, so I don't know whether the other files can import this one, or whether this file can import a shared lower-level file. The curlTest and curlTestLp definitions looked like genuine new constructions. fieldDerivative_linear and fieldDerivatives_commute are theorem-level and excluded. The case for consolidating is moderate, because the library may have kept the copies separate to avoid import dependencies.

findings.problem: This file defines the map r ↦ r • e₀, ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), as its own `scalarEmbedding`. The same continuous linear map is defined separately at least twice more in the project. `EulerMeanSobolevBoundedField.scalarEmbedding` uses `(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) 1)`. `EulerCylinderScalarPrimitive.scalarEmbed` is `toSpanSingleton ℝ unitVector`, where `unitVector := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1`. `Vector3` and `Space` are both abbreviations for `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)`, so the targets are definitionally the same. Each copy needs its own API (inner product lemma here, norm and projection lemmas in CylinderScalarPrimitive). The maps are only propositionally equal, so converting between them needs extra rewriting. `EulerCylinderScalarPrimitive` already opens `EulerLiftedGradientSpace`, the same lifted setting as this file, so the copies are not in unrelated areas.
findings.proposed_change: Keep one canonical scalar embedding in a low-level shared file. For example, define it once as `toSpanSingleton ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)` together with its inner, norm and projection lemmas. Then make `EulerLiftedCurl.scalarEmbedding`, `EulerMeanSobolevBoundedField.scalarEmbedding` and `EulerCylinderScalarPrimitive.scalarEmbed` reuse it, either as abbreviations or by deleting them and updating call sites. If a name must stay, state it as `abbrev` or prove a `rfl` or `ext` equality to the canonical one.
findings.benefit: One definition with one set of simp lemmas (inner, norm, projection). This avoids re-proving the same facts and avoids rewriting between three propositionally equal maps when the cylinder, Sobolev and lifted-curl developments are combined.

evidence.excerpt: def scalarEmbed : ℝ →L[ℝ] Space := toSpanSingleton ℝ unitVector
